claims.claim: _prove_context accepts exactly the legacy empty-list shape and the optional non-empty string defaultBrowserContextId shape. Unsupported keys and malformed fields fail closed; the default ID supplies no identity or authority.
Context proof requires exactly one matching Playwright context and checks that the context list remains stable after bounded CDP-session detach within the acquisition deadline.

Expected bridge failures and cancellation receive deterministic BROWSER_CONTEXT_UNPROVEN classification; timeouts remain ACQUISITION_TIMED_OUT. Failed disconnect cannot mask the acquisition reason, and no additional page request is authorized.

Acquisition issues at most one page request, requires about:blank in the proved context, rejects page/context/target drift, navigates only the bound chat URL, and repeats exact owner proof before exposing the page for editing.

Added production-shaped inert regression coverage uses the real bounded bridge and synthetic launch/CDP/OS inputs through both accepted context shapes, page creation, exact navigation, repeated owner proof, and existing pre-submit checks, stopping before editing or Send.
Documentation records the production-compatible context proof, deterministic failure boundary, machine-local privacy, and separate Human/Brain H4D live exit gate.
Listener/profile/owner classifiers and local delivery safeguards remain unchanged, with their existing regression coverage retained.
